decision.choice: CitationPanel accepts an optional judgmentId and links the in-app reader when given; the drafts page does not feed it because the stored draft citation report has no judgment id (authority.resolution), so until it does the panel links only browsable http(s) sources and never an archive URL

amendments.why: Feeding judgmentId needs a core drafting report and stored resolution change outside the contract; R1 (no .tar link) holds without it

decision.choice: Treat the matter relevant-judgments page as a private, noindex page (robots index:false, follow:false, commit f67a28b4) rather than adding a design spec, screenshots, canonical URL, JSON-LD and a sitemap entry

amendments.why: It is an authenticated per-matter workspace page (needs matter.read, other workspaces get notFound); the only change under D12 is the link target. Public-page SEO gates (canonical, structured data, sitemap) do not apply and would leak private routes; noindex removes it from the public page set (forgedock pageFiles returns [] for the diff). Visual change is limited to one link href, so no 390/1440 capture is needed.
